sources.title: Trace-Inverter-4B-NoBubble API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Trace-Inverter-4B-NoBubble is inspired by the no-summary/no-bubble formulation of Zhang et al., but is not an exact reproduction of their no-summary training experiment. Its target traces were originally generated by a bubble-conditioned inversion model, while the student itself receives no bubble information.

sources.title: Developer releases Trace-Inverter-4B, a Qwen 4B fine-tune for synthetic ...
sources.snippet: A developer released Trace-Inverter-4B, a fine-tuned Qwen 4B model that reconstructs synthetic reasoning traces from only a prompt and final answer, building on the paper 'How to Steal Reasoning Without Reasoning Traces'. The model uses Jackrong's datasets of synthetic traces and offers an alternative approach to the original trace-inverter.
